function.name: book_find
function.description: Find a book in a library based on specific criteria like author, genre or publication year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: historical_landmark_find
function.description: Find historical landmarks based on specific criteria like location or era. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

era.description: Era of the landmark. E.g. Middle Ages, Renaissance

function.name: artwork_find
function.description: Locate artwork in museums based on specific criteria like type of material, artist, or era. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

museum.description: The name of the museum, e.g. Modern Arts Museum, New York

type.description: Type of the artwork. E.g. Painting, Sculpture

material.description: Material of the artwork if it's a sculpture. E.g. Bronze, Marble
